wind_speed.meaning: spread responds to wind more (β<0 in T1) or less than the model says, or the wind input is biased where it is strong

wind_aloft.meaning: strong wind aloft that the surface analysis does not bring down to the fire

lee_descent_1km.meaning: downslope wind: ground falling along the wind aloft

lee_descent_5km.meaning: downslope windstorm on the lee of a ridge

wind_run.meaning: heading against flanking and backing spread is out of balance

calm_share.formula: b · share of hours with U₁₀ < 2 m/s
calm_share.meaning: creep and burnout in calm air (the model keeps a fire alive, or kills it, in light wind)

night_share.formula: b · share of hours at night
night_share.meaning: night recovery of moisture and stable air

crew_hours.meaning: suppression: crews hold lines once they are in place

road_distance.formula: b · ln(distance to a road line)
road_distance.meaning: roads as lines crews hold or fire fails to cross

distance.meaning: the miss grows or shrinks with the length of the run

clock.meaning: bookkeeping: the residual holds the observed time itself (not physics)

fuel_grass.formula: δ · share of grass on the line

fuel_shrub.formula: δ · share of shrub on the line

fuel_timber.formula: δ · share of timber on the line
fuel_timber.meaning: timber litter and understorey spread rate is off

fuel_nonburnable.formula: δ · share of non-burnable on the line
fuel_nonburnable.meaning: barriers stop or pass fire differently than modelled

fuel_developed.formula: δ · share of developed land on the line
fuel_developed.meaning: fire through built-up land (houses as fuel) is off

canopy_cover.formula: b · canopy cover on the line
canopy_cover.meaning: wind sheltering under canopy, or crown fire, is off

slope_run.meaning: the slope factor (Rothermel: ∝ tan²φ) is off

slope_any.meaning: steep ground of any aspect (rolling material, terrain-channelled wind)

ember.formula: b · Σ canopy(x upwind) e^(−x/L) / Σ e^(−x/L)
ember.meaning: spotting from canopy fuel within L upwind

building_density.meaning: fire among houses moves differently than in wildland fuel

verdict: group-level: can't be told from plain offsets over 138 groups
